Thanks for taking a look at this. Forge Consulting has been running implementation programs for data platforms and AI tooling for the past 6 years. We're seeing a lot of demand from our clients to accelerate production readiness for LLM-powered features, and we'd like to propose a joint SI Ops Accelerator with Redwood that helps our consultants get to a co-delivery-ready state in 4–6 weeks.

High-level ask:
- A 90-minute enablement session for senior consultants (overview + product capabilities)
- A 2-day hands-on lab where consultants run through sandbox deployments, routing policies, and caching strategies
- A partner playbook (1–2 pages) tailored for our consulting engagements that outlines recommended rollout steps, common operational runbooks, and SLA expectations

Deliverables we can share from our side: client engagement templates, sample SoWs, and a short case study.

Can you confirm who we should work with at Redwood to scope curriculum, pricing (training credits vs. billable delivery), and a proposed week in December? I've attached a short outline of the Accelerator we typically run.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to align this week.

Thanks Kim — looping in a couple of operational notes from an enablement/delivery perspective: 

- Recommended format: 90-minute product + architecture primer (mixed internal/external participants), followed by a 2-day hands-on lab in a hosted sandbox. The hands-on should include: model routing policies, autoscaling scenarios, cache priming exercises, and a roll-back/fallback test.
- Personnel: I can serve as delivery lead for the product sessions. For the lab days we will pair your senior consultants with a Redwood engineer (2:1 ratio preferred). That assumes we run a cohort of up to 8 consultants.
- Pricing: For pilots we typically apply training credits equivalent to one full engineer-day per host + a $2,500 lab setup fee. If Forge wants Redwood engineers on-site or dedicated for more than the lab days we would switch to co-billing.
- Compliance: If any client use-cases require customer-managed keys or on-prem routing, flag that on the discovery call — labs will need extra lead time for network/VPC prep.

Oliver — can you share the attendee list by Monday? Also attaching a short checklist we use for lab readiness. If Forge is comfortable, we can provision the sandbox the week before the lab to smoke-test the exercises.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Partner Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
